name: Gamma-Corrected Hemispherical Shading
definition: A shading approximation for Fourier Volume Rendering that replaces the non-linear max(0, N·L) diffuse operator with a polynomial approximation of hemispherical shading raised to a gamma power, allowing linear operations in the Fourier domain while preserving visual contrast.
summary: Gamma-Corrected Hemispherical Shading approximates diffuse illumination in Fourier Volume Rendering using a cubic polynomial to cull back-lit surfaces while preserving Fourier linearity.
